card.name: The digit 9 in 99 and 99m
card.fires_on: The second digit 9 in a number starting with 9, mostly in 99%, >99.9% or technetium Tc 99m. It also fires on the % after 99.999.

modes.label: Percent near 99
modes.description: The final 9 of 99 or 99.9 in percent figures such as protein binding or accuracy.
modes.example: Ospemifene is more than 9<<9>>% bound to serum proteins

modes.label: Technetium Tc 99m
modes.description: The second 9 in the isotope name Tc 99m.
modes.example: Administer sodium pertechnetate Tc 9<<9>>m injection intravenously.

card.plain: It marks the second 9 in numbers like 99%, or in the isotope name Tc 99m.
